thread:
dara: Proposal: change SDK behavior so missing route headers return a clear client-side warning and a non-silent fallback. Idea: add `route_behavior` param with values `legacy|legacy-bucket|strict`.

leo: Summary of modes?

dara: `legacy` = current silent rewrite (deprecated). `legacy-bucket` = keep app alive but attribute to tenant-scoped `legacy` route so console billing is correct. `strict` = raise an error encouraging immediate fix.

mica: Nice. Timeline suggestion: minor A add param + WARN telemetry (default legacy), minor B flip default to `legacy-bucket`, minor C flip to `strict` with major deprecation notice, major D remove legacy mode.

leo: For Go SDK: careful with transport wrappers; the shim that sets the header must run before any retry wrapper. Add an integration test that injects a flaky RoundTripper to validate ordering.

dara: Telemetry: emit `route_behavior` tag + `legacy_bucket_hit` boolean. Console will sample 2k requests per tenant during canary to show hotspots.

mica: Console changes: add a tenant tile for "legacy route %" and an admin modal 7 days prior to flips. Also provide a migration helper listing top callers and PR templates.

ops-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for 2025-11-05T18:00Z -> SDK canary pipelines triggered. :rocket:

dara: Docs: migration guide, CLI k8s patch using `REDWOOD_ROUTE_LEGACY_SHIM=true` for emergency, changelog entry, and code snippets for python/ts/go.

leo: I'll open tickets for the routing flag so infra can map missing headers to `legacy` bucket per tenant. Link will go into the docs.

mica: I'll mock UI tiles and the admin modal and share designs in this thread.

dara: Action items: leo -> routing API toggle ticket + smoke test plan; mica -> console tile + docs copy; leo/mica -> SDK PRs for param + telemetry; everyone -> test canary and report.

ops-bot: CI: devex/route-behavior-tests queued.
